messages:
maria: Heads-up 1: OpenRepo wants to list OR-13B in our marketplace and ship a vendor SI kit with EdgeCo. Theyre asking for co-announcement late-May.

devon: Copy. Do we have the actual licensing text? Need to confirm redistribution + quantization permissions before we do any packaging.

maria: I have a first-pass license they sent. Its basically permissive but includes a dataset restriction addendum (non-commercial use for dataset X). Ill attach the PDF to the ops doc after the sync.

sam: From product: we need three things for the listing: provenance blurb, SLO expectations for hosted vs dedicated, and a short "disallowed uses" section.

alex: Technical: SI kit requires a reference serving container, tokenizers in HF format, and a quantized weight artifact. Are they ok with us distributing a 4-bit quantized variant?

devon: Legally thats allowed only if we get a signed redistribution amendment permitting transformations (quantize/repackage). Also need an export compliance attestation and explicit attribution text for the marketplace UI.

maria: Action: Ill send amendment request and ask for the compliance attestation. @cam can you draft the marketplace blurb placeholder once we have the legal snippet?

cam: Yep. Ill draft a short listing blurb + a joint blog outline. Prefer co-authored PR. Also want an embargo calendar entry.

ops-bot: Partnership page created: https://docs.internal.redwood/partnerships/openrepo-or13b (edit: maria, alex, devon, sam, cam)

sam: Minimal SI deliverables proposal (quick list):
```
- HF model package + tokenizer.json
- quantized 4-bit weights + fp16 checksum
- serving container (Redwood runtime)
- perf report (latency @seq128 p50/p95)
- small eval set + reg thresholds
- signed redistribution & attestation docs
```

alex: I can produce the perf run in ~3 business days after we have weights + target EdgeCo spec. Also confirm whether they want ONNX or native PT - we prefer HF + PyTorch artifact.

maria: Ill ask them to push HF artifacts and provenance details. Also request a contact at EdgeCo for integration testing.

devon: One more legal ask: add a marketplace checkbox for "dataset restrictions" if their addendum limits certain uses. Will draft a short policy snippet.

cam: Draft outline for blog: headline, partner quotes, technical optimizations, SI integration case study, and a short customer snippet. Ill post the first draft tomorrow.

maria: Risks called out: 1) addendum could require extra legal review 2) export controls may restrict some regions 3) SI partner availability for validation windows.

sam: Mitigations: parallelize legal + eng work, prepare region toggles for SKUs, keep announcement date soft until legal signs.

alex: Note: if they request 8-bit kernels well need extra validation (add ~2 days). Also need to know preferred batch/seq targets for perf tuning.

maria: Timeline: I aim to have signed amendment + attestation by EOD Tue. Alex to queue perf run once artifacts arrive. Devon to prepare legal blurb. Cam to coordinate embargo with PR ops after sign-off.

devon: Ill post a tiny attribution clause that we can embed in the listing (one-liner + linkback).

cam: :thumbsup: will align messaging with brand + partner.

maria: Thanks all. Ill update the partnership doc when vendor returns signed docs. Ping this thread for blockers.

ops-bot: Ticket updated: PRT-4827 status=awaiting_vendor_documents
